Name: (AT) Swimmy and Sam
Author: RitzyGen
Description:
Hey y'all, It me again.
I was looking around for AT mods that looked like my cats, but couldn't find exactly what I wanted. so I made one.

thought you guys might enjoy it a little.

[size=4]REQUIREMENTS: SMAPI, Alternative Textures

[/size][size=3]links:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures
[/url]
[/size][size=4]
[/size]

[size=4]INSTALL INSTRUCTIONS: Move the .zip file to your Stardew Valley/Mods folder and unzip the files.[/size]


This mod is only on nexus! Please do not download anywhere else.

Also, I feel like mentioning, If anyone would like me to, I am willing to make an AT pack for your cat/dog, if you have one. I would need pictures for this(of your cat/dog), or a description, also if it's just a description, I may not get it exactly right on the first try. Thanks!
